mentions.name: magic-switch
mentions.description: A small macOS application that lets users share a Magic Keyboard and Magic Trackpad between multiple Macs, switching the peripherals back and forth either manually or automatically.
mentions.problem: There was no good way to switch a Magic Keyboard and Magic Trackpad between different Macs.
mentions.source_excerpt: I couldn't find a good way switch them between different Macs, so I made https://github.com/MegaManSec/magic-switch. It's a small application which allows you to basically share the peripherals between Macs, and send them back-and-forth either manually or automatically.
mentions.author: mmsc
